question: Does fixed480Hz external impedance feedback reduce native480/960Hz approach and impact sensitivity relative to the original120Hz feedback?
conditional_launch_rule: Run only if the original480/960Hz prefix pair fails its registered gate after the single960Hz extension. No additional controller tuning from these cases.

independent_rationale.fact: FORGE paper reports15Hz policy targets and1000Hz real-robot impedance control.
independent_rationale.inference: 480Hz is a fixed integer subdivision compatible with the existing15/120Hz clocks and permits a matched480/960 native test. It tests feedback bandwidth, not hardware reproduction.

high_level_controller: Unchanged first-attempt script. All applied high-level prefix actions must match from identical initialization; only native feedback/terminal hold opportunity frequency changes.

acceptance.prefix_gate: For adjacent finest resolutions: at most one difference in prefix abort count, at most two individual outcome changes among 28; median paired peak wrist and contact-impulse relative differences <=20%, with every outlier and exposure difference reported. Positive fixture/finger controls, native CPU replay and unchanged coarse reference must pass.
acceptance.extension: Run 960 Hz once if 240/480 fails any material outcome or load-stability margin. This is a diagnostic extension, not a claim that three timesteps prove convergence.
acceptance.training_gate: A prefix pass alone does not enable substantial training. At the selected finest stable pair rerun frozen learned direct, learned continuation and unchanged retry for complete30s jobs; no more than one completion-count difference and two individual outcome differences per arm, no forbidden events, retained force/dwell/observation contracts. Alternatively identify and independently justify a physical-model or API correction, register it, and rerun affected common controls.
acceptance.stop: Spend at most three distinct explanation-driven probe variants or two hours of simulator diagnosis after this prefix series. If no interpretable force-limited task is established, reject the current comparative-training premise for this cycle and retain a concrete numerical-sensitivity result; do not spend large training merely to produce candidate scores.

interpretation_rule: Compare native refinement within each fixedservo condition and compare feedback conditions at each fixednative resolution. Better completion alone does not prove numerical correctness. Adoption for training requires the registered full-job learned/retry validation at the new common feedback/physics definition.
scope_and_limitations: Conditional four-second causal diagnostic only; no candidate training or finaltests.
Explicit controller/task-condition change shared across the causalpair. Historical120Hz results remain separate.
A fixed480Hz feedback test is not pure solver convergence or replication of1000Hz hardware. Do not weaken scriptedretry or alterforcecriterion for a score.
Native force aborts and all censored/failed/absorbing work retained.120Hz block aggregates are sensor intervals containingfour servo updates.
